test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Mathematics (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: A seller marks their goods 45% above the cost price. On customer demand, they offer a 60% reduction on the bills. What percentage of profit or loss does the seller make?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹100 (Assume)

Mark-up = 45% above CP

Discount = 60% on Marked Price (MP)

**Formula used:**

Marked Price (MP) = CP × (1 + Mark-up Percentage / 100)

Selling Price (SP) = MP × (1 - Discount Percentage / 100)

Profit/Loss = SP - CP

Profit/Loss Percentage = (Profit/Loss / CP) × 100
